scenario: named/bind-dyndb-ldap fails to start after an LDIF restore drops the DNS service ACIs
notes: journal_named shows the documented LDAP 'Insufficient access' signature under cn=dns, so named-service-down fires with upstream_candidates=['directory-server'] and HIGH confidence. Because named being down also breaks live resolution of the system records, IPADNSSystemRecordsCheck independently reports ERROR and dns_lookup corroborates broken SRV/A records, so srv-autodiscovery also fires (DIAGNOSED, HIGH) as a second, independent-scoring diagnosis within the same pack - it is not demoted to RELATED_SYMPTOM because upstream_candidates demotion only applies across packs, not within one pack's own rules. named-service-down outscores it (CRITICAL vs ERROR severity) and takes PRIMARY_PROBLEM.
